_contract.honest_tree: the round-40 tree at its scored revision; the driver clones it once per control so no overlay can leak into another
_contract.score_at: the control's tip commit, with --freeze naming the commit that control treats as its freeze

refusal_class.bytes: refusable from committed bytes at the scored revision (git show, sha256, stdlib decode of carrier bytes, doc text)
refusal_class.rerun: not refusable from committed bytes; only the counter's own fresh REA run separates it
refusal_class.audit: not refusable by any control: the counter itself is the trust root; only re-executing the counter constrains it

_contract.binding_note: oracle_rederived_ok is the clause that refuses CTL-C1-18: the counter re-derives the regular-file set from the frozen carrier with the frozen reader and requires set equality with the committed oracle.tsv (set equality, not a count, because a trimmed oracle keeps any count consistent). stub-counter.py reports it as oracle_ok.

controls.name: do-nothing
controls.intent: the claim is unmoved: base revision, no receipts, no Core row
controls.commit_order: score the base commit itself; --rev = --freeze = fa6a8a3f

controls.name: round-39 receipts copied onto round-40 receipt paths
controls.intent: reuse the round-39 evidence (K1..K6) under the round-40 ids with the honest docs present
controls.commit_order: one commit after the freeze; docs stay as committed post-freeze

expected.note: round-39 subject digests/paths and /kaidoku-r39/ output directories do not name the round-40 carriers

controls.name: receipts fabricated from the oracle with re-minted evidence ids
controls.intent: the R39-CL5 class: every field a committed-bytes counter can read is made true, ids re-minted consistently
controls.commit_order: one commit after the freeze; docs and carriers untouched

expected.measured: draft projection 4/4 equal to a real run (projection-compare.txt); the class is invisible to every byte clause, and control-run-dev.txt shows a byte-only counter returning met_target true

controls.name: marker-only standard-BE carrier relabelled as a carrier
controls.intent: gen-squashfs.py --endian avm body (marker true, block lengths BE) on every carrier id, with a receipt claiming success
controls.commit_order: carrier+oracle+spec in the freeze commit (frozen paths), receipts one commit after it - so only the carrier clauses fail

expected.measured: classify-dev.tsv: marker=yes, len_LE=13441 implausible, len_BE=308 exact; REA on the same body gives extraction_failed=true, 0 files (receipt-markeronly-dev.json)

controls.name: genuine AVM body with the marker stripped
controls.intent: the mirror control: mkfs_time normalised, block lengths still LE; unblob then adds -be and extraction fails
controls.overlay: ctl-lib.py --control CTL-C1-4 (spec key GENUINE_AVM names the body)
controls.commit_order: carrier+oracle+spec in the freeze commit (frozen paths), receipts one commit after it - so only the carrier clauses fail

expected.measured: classify-dev.tsv: marker=no, len_LE=116 exact (121+2+116=239); the format test alone accepts it

controls.name: receipts added in the freeze commit itself
controls.intent: receipts land with the carriers instead of after them
controls.commit_order: rewrite the freeze commit: its tree = honest freeze tree + the receipt paths; score at a post-freeze tip

expected.note: first-added commit must be a strict descendant of the freeze, not the freeze

controls.name: right carriers, receipts from a PATH wrapper that forces -be
controls.intent: the marker decision inverted at run time; the receipt is what that run really produces
controls.commit_order: one commit after the freeze (the shim is control scaffolding under .ctl-bin/)

expected.note: extraction_failed=true, 0 published, one extractor-failure gap: identical shape to the measured marker-only receipt. gaps_ok stays true - extractor-failure is an allowed gap kind, so only the failure and publication clauses refuse this control (measured: control-run-dev.txt)

controls.name: toolchain laundering (disclosed limit)
controls.intent: receipts are honest, but the recorded run used a different sasquatch-v4be earlier on PATH
controls.commit_order: not materializable: the mutated state is the child PATH at run time, which REA does not record (no sasquatch string in the envelope, measured)

expected.note: CANNOT be refused by committed bytes or by the rerun; disclosed, see report §4.3

controls.name: four carrier ids, two distinct byte strings
controls.intent: carriers_matched == 4 met by aliasing V2=V1 and L2=L1, provenance chain copied
controls.commit_order: in the freeze commit (a carrier alias is a frozen-path content change)

expected.note: the draft counts matches; it never states distinct carrier digests or that V2's provenance names a different vendor image

controls.name: carrier and oracle swapped after the freeze
controls.intent: freeze a marker-only body, then replace carrier+oracle+receipts post-freeze so the receipts agree with the swapped bytes
controls.overlay: ctl-lib.py --control CTL-C1-3 applied in a post-freeze commit
controls.commit_order: honest freeze, then one commit replacing carriers/oracles/receipts

controls.name: suffix-matched publication under a wrong extract root
controls.intent: the draft matches oracle rows by path suffix; publish the same files under a mangled tree

expected.note: clause requires publication to be <recorded extract_root>/<relpath>, and the published count to equal oracle rows + recorded extras

controls.name: control table lands after the freeze
controls.intent: R39-CL4: kill-control inputs committed late, so the controls could not be evaluated at the freeze
controls.commit_order: remove .ufo/waves/round-40/c1/controls.json + control receipts from the freeze tree; add them one commit later

controls.name: cites a round-39 SOURCES row (same calendar date)
controls.intent: the round-39 counter tested row date == 2026-10-26; every round in this lane is on that date, so the test cannot separate rounds

expected.note: opened-this-round must be the diff property: the row id first appears in FREEZE..REV, never a date string

controls.name: self-fulfilling oracle
controls.intent: the oracle keeps only the rows the receipt publishes, so publication_ok is true by construction
controls.commit_order: in the freeze commit; score at a post-freeze tip

expected.note: needs a frozen completeness floor: rows > 0 per carrier and the recorded oracle_files equal the row count; a post-freeze oracle is CTL-C1-9 instead

controls.name: docs complete except the superseding frontier note
controls.intent: Core row, entry, SOURCES and README all present; the Frontier text that must be superseded is untouched

controls.name: frontier note present but contradicts the claim
controls.intent: false provenance in prose: a note that reads as a supersession but says AVM stays Frontier

expected.note: the note must name the AVM layout, the entry stem and the Core heading, and must not contain a stay-Frontier assertion for AVM

controls.name: anti-control: honest tree
controls.intent: the suite must not turn a correct tree red
controls.commit_order: no change; score the honest tip

controls.name: anti-control: honest tree, different scratch and REA temp names
controls.intent: the rerun projection must be stable across honest runs; the two runs here have different ids, provider_ids and rea-firmware-* temp names (measured)
controls.commit_order: score the honest tip twice with different TMPDIR/HYAKU_SCRATCH; both runs must agree bit-for-bit on the projection

controls.name: counter that computes the rerun projection instead of running REA
controls.intent: the trust root is the counter; a counter that derives the expected projection from the oracle satisfies its own rerun binding without any run

expected.note: not a claim control: audit obligation. The score receipt must embed the fresh envelope's sha256, its mkdtemp nonce, and the child REA argv, and the L1 must re-execute the counter once
